name: Lysander Spellhardt
desc:
Lysander is a male Lightborn located at [The Floating Keep](location:the_floating_keep).

Lysander asks you to gather the nessecary materials to craft a Hallowtide Mask. Once you have all the proper ingredients, which can be found in any chests, he will craft a Hallowtide Mask for you.

Lysander sells you various Hallowtide\-exclusive items for Joy, though they are all usually comestics and or useful tools. Here are all the possible purchasable options from **Lysander Spellhardt**:

**2025:**

With 2025 Hallowtide, came with the '25 medal on top of the equipments from last years.

1.  Relic \[100 Joy\] - Gives you a random Relic. All Relics have the same drop rate.
2.  Familiar Priest's Helm \[35 Joy\]
3.  Familiar Heretic's Helm \[35 Joy\]
4.  Familiar Knight's Helm \[35 Joy\]
5.  Familiar Heretic's Armor \[35 Joy\]
6.  Familiar Knight's Armor \[35 Joy\]
7.  Pumpkin Head \[50 Joy\]
8.  Mushroom Costume \[100 Joy\]
9.  Hallowtide Race Variant \[70 Joy\] - Unlocks a Hallowtide racial variant for all of your races. This purchase is account-wide, unlocking for your current and future slots and races.
10.  Hallowtide '25 Medal \[300 Joy\] - Read Below
11.  Hallowtide '24 Medal \[200 Joy\] - Read Below
12.  Hallowtide '23 Medal \[200 Joy\] - Read Below
13.  Hallowtide '22 Medal \[200 Joy\] - Read Below
    -   Can be used to trade in your Knowledge in exchange for Hallowtide-exclusive items released during its respective year at a [Blacksmith](entity:blacksmith). Read more on Seasonal Medals

**2024:**

With 2024 Hallowtide, came with 2 newly-added Hallowtide-exclusive outfits on top of the equipments from last years. Buying a random Deep Gem was replaced with buying a random Relic. Though, this all happened only on the second week of Hallowtide, on the November 8th, 2024 update.

1.  Relic \[100 Joy\] - Gives you a random Relic. All Relics have the same drop rate.
2.  Familiar Priest's Helm \[35 Joy\]
3.  Familiar Heretic's Helm \[35 Joy\]
4.  Familiar Knight's Helm \[35 Joy\]
5.  Familiar Heretic's Armor \[35 Joy\]
6.  Familiar Knight's Armor \[35 Joy\]
7.  Pumpkin Head \[50 Joy\]
8.  Mushroom Costume \[100 Joy\]
9.  Hallowtide Race Variant \[70 Joy\] - Unlocks a Hallowtide racial variant for all of your races. This purchase is account-wide, unlocking for your current and future slots and races.
10.  Hallowtide '24 Medal \[300 Joy\] - Read Below
11.  Hallowtide '23 Medal \[200 Joy\] - Read Below
12.  Hallowtide '22 Medal \[200 Joy\] - Read Below
    -   Can be used to trade in your Knowledge in exchange for Hallowtide-exclusive items released during its respective year at a [Blacksmith](entity:blacksmith). Read more on Seasonal Medals

**2023:**

With 2023 Hallowtide, came with 2 newly-added Hallowtide-exclusive equipments on top of the stuff from last year. The option to buy a Void Feather was removed as well. The Hallowtide '22 and '23 Medals came on the second week of Hallowtide, on the November 3rd, 2023 update.

1.  Deep Gem \[15 Joy\]
2.  Familiar Priest's Helm \[35 Joy\]
3.  Familiar Heretic's Helm \[35 Joy\]
4.  Familiar Knight's Helm \[35 Joy\]
5.  Pumpkin Head \[50 Joy\]
6.  Mushroom Costume \[100 Joy\]
7.  Hallowtide Variant \[70 Joy\] - Unlocks a Hallowtide racial variant for all of your races. This purchase is account-wide, unlocking for your current and future slots and races.
8.  Hallowtide '23 Medal \[300 Joy\] - Read Below
9.  Hallowtide '22 Medal \[200 Joy\] - Read Below
    -   Can be used to trade in your Knowledge in exchange for Hallowtide-exclusive items released during its respective year at a [Blacksmith](entity:blacksmith). Read more on Seasonal Medals

**2022:**

With 2022 Hallowtide, came with 3 Hallowtide-exclusive head equipments, and a Hallowtide Racial Variant, which is an account-wide unlock. You also had an option to buy a Void Feather and a random Deep Gems as well. This happened on the October 31st, 2022 update.

1.  Void Feather \[15 Joy\]
2.  Deep Gem \[15 Joy\]
3.  Familiar Priest Helmet \[30 Joy\]
4.  Familiar Heretic Helmet \[35 Joy\]
5.  Familiar Knight Helmet \[50 Joy\]
6.  Hallowtide Variant \[70 Joy\] - Unlocks a Hallowtide racial variant for all of your races. This purchase is account-wide, unlocking for your current and future slots and races.
additional_info:
-   Glaive says the same dialogue when you succeed in buying anything.
-   There used to be an option to buy Void Feathers and a random Deep Gem, though the latter was replaced with buying a random Relic.
    -   Buying a random Relic used to cost 30 Joy, and had both Rain and Void spire relics in its lootpool.
-   Mantle of Enmity, Fauld of Enmity and Imperator's Fury used to be obtainable from Lysander Spellhardt.
-   According to [Mikhail Spellhardt](entity:mikhail_spellhardt), Lysander is as old, if not older, than [Galpin Spellhardt](entity:galpin_spellhardt_musicologist_extraordinaire), despite one looking much older than the other. Also according to Mikhail, this is because a Lightborn's appearance reflects their feelings, which is why Galpin is so old as he reminisces about their homeland a lot.
